in_greek.name: Μαναήν
in_greek.long_meaning: Ὁ Μαναήν ἦν προφήτης ἐν Ἀντιοχείᾳ, μετὰ τοῦ Σαύλου, καὶ ἦν ἀνήρ πίστος καὶ ἀγαπητός, καὶ εἶχεν ἰδιαίτερη σημασία ἐν τῇ Ἐκκλησίᾳ τῶν πρώτων Χριστιανῶν

in_latin.name: Manaen

data.cultural_impact: The name Manaen carries a strong sense of esteem and respect within Christian communities. It is a biblical name, mentioned in the New Testament as the name of a leading man in the early Christian church who welcomed St. Peter into his home when he was fleeing from Herod Agrippa I. This association with biblical history adds to the tradition and prestige often associated with the name.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Manaen holds deep spiritual significance as it is a reminder of the importance of dedication and service to God. The Hebrew origin of the name emphasizes this connection, as 'en' refers to God, emphasizing the importance of acknowledging and serving God in all aspects of life. This makes Manaen an inspiring name for those striving to live a pious and prayerful life rooted in Christian faith.

historical_references.reference: Manaen is mentioned in the New Testament as a high-ranking official under King Herod Antipas, who was the ruler of Galilee and Perea from 4 BCE to 39 CE.

Manaen is also identified as the foster brother of Herod Antipas, making him a member of the Herodian dynasty. This is inferred from Acts 11:19, where he is introduced as a distinguished man among the early Christian community in Antioch.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's world, the name Manaen continues to be cherished by Christian families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.

name_in_real_life.story: Ruth Manaen from Rome, Italy embodies the meaning of Manaen - "Man of God". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Manaen: A man of refinement and nobility in faith, bearing the grace of God's forgiveness and generosity, symbolizing the transformation of a high-ranking Pharisee into a humble disciple of Christ.
